fixups.title: Выложить источник данных и провайдер дашбордов grafana

installed./etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources/sa:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: VictoriaMetrics
    uid: vm
    type: prometheus
    access: proxy
    url: http://127.0.0.1:8429
    isDefault: true
installed./etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards/sa-:
apiVersion: 1
providers:
  - name: sa-home
    type: file
    allowUiUpdates: false
    updateIntervalSeconds: 30
    options:
      path: /var/lib/metrics-hub/dashboards
      foldersFromFilesStructure: true
